reviewed_version: Author-hosted journal-form Annals of Probability53(1),2025,299-354,56physical pages
summary: Exact square tableau endpoint counterexample also disproves uniform kernel convergence used in Theorem5 proof. Two separate local defects concern countable events and a degenerate L-shape boundary.

problems.claim: Theorem16 frozen local limit is empty also at t0=0,1; the proof of Theorem5 asserts uniform kernel convergence on compact sets of the whole closed parameter rectangle to justify integration.
assumptions: Uniform normalized Lebesgue law on order polytope
x0=0,t0=1; arithmetic condition x0*sqrt(|lambda0|) integer holds
problems.check: At endpoint critical equation U^2=0 makes it frozen. Unique maximal entry V has CDF s^(n^2) by homogeneity. Rescaled bead(0,n(V-1)) belongs to {0}x[-1,0] with probability1-(1-1/n)^(n^2)->1, disproving empty limit. Similarly minimum at0.
problems.finite_evidence: For s_n=1-1/n^2, f_N(s)>=n*s^(n^2-1), f(s)=1/(pi*sqrt(s*(1-s))), liminf(f_N(s_n)-f(s_n))/n>=1/e-1/pi>0. Exact finite positive rational lower bounds retained.
problems.counterevidence: Interior liquid analysis not contradicted. Extreme bead integrated normalized mass1/n vanishes. Square limiting density integrates to(2/pi)asin(sqrt(t)) and1 at t=1; global height formula not disproved.
problems.correction: Remove time endpoints from bulk local-limit statement or prove distinct endpoint result. Replace false uniformity in Theorem5 proof with endpoint/critical-time control, e.g. a justified cumulative-height or uniform-integrability argument.
problems.repair_verification: No general repaired proof claimed. One maximum has N(1-V)->Exp(1); this is not the full endpoint process.
problems.impact: Major for demonstrated invalid derivation materially tied to central height formula; no assertion whole paper or corrected formula fails.

problems.claim: Proposition22 gives convergence of probabilities for arbitrary countable Boolean combinations of continuity-set cylinders.
assumptions: Deterministic locally finite counting measures on Z x R
problems.check: A=union_k{mu:mu(B_k)=1}. nu_n in A by k>n, nu not in A. Probabilities1 versus0.
problems.counterevidence: Finite cylinder combinations and correct continuity-event portmanteau theorem hold. Corollary19 proof pp352-353 uses Skorohod coupling and finite random cutoff; no core use of false extension established.
problems.correction: Use finite Boolean combinations or require A to be continuity event for limiting law.
dependency: Section2.2 general topology claim only; no necessary main-result dependency found
problems.impact: False local auxiliary proposition; core local-tableau limit not refuted.

problems.claim: Proposition11 parameter domain includes q<=min(p+2,2r-p) while Eq20 and proof require strict interlacing.
assumptions: Rational p=1/2,q=3/2,r=1 belongs to displayed domain
problems.check: Coordinates(-1,0,1/2,1/2,1) have a1=b2. Cancel repeated corner to get square transition transform U/(U^2-1), whose surface is continuous; printed r=1 condition p=0 or q=2-sqrt(2-p^2) is false.
problems.counterevidence: Genuine L-shape interpretation would exclude the point, but that is a stricter domain than printed. Nondegenerate theorem not refuted.
problems.correction: Use strict q upper bound for genuine L-shapes and separate degenerate rectangles.
problems.impact: Local domain/range error with explicit consequence; no damage demonstrated for strictly interlacing criterion.
